author: reek
body: Wire format serialization boundary. Every type that crosses the TCP/HTTP boundary gets serialized here. No other chapter should build JSON strings. This is the single place where Codex data structures become wire-format text, and the single place to change if the wire format changes.

author: reek
body: The HTML plug emits these as JavaScript functions. The CDX server calls them at route boundaries. No domain logic here -- just structure-to-text conversion.
